title: NetherStuff
description: A small expansion to the Nether dimension, keeping the Vanilla feel.
body:
![NetherStuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f25d94e8f3fa084bf0b5404499703b178c6f601e.png)

---

![About the Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abc18dff5bc7bab42ee6e52dfe70532ddbcb1825.jpeg)
**NetherStuff** is a mod for Minecraft: Java Edition, designed to expand the gameplay experience in "The Nether" dimension in a Vanilla Feeling. This mod includes:

- Unique Items: Obtain rare items such as Music Disc`s and more.
- Custom Tabs: Easily find all new blocks and items in a dedicated creative inventory tab.

Additional features are available, such as:

- Custom Textures
- Only Compatibility with NeoForge
- Integration with existing mods
- And much more!

> **Note for Modrinth moderators and users:**  
> This project is the **official continuation** of the original version that was previously uploaded under my organization account.  
> I was the **sole developer and maintainer** of that project, and I’m now continuing its development here under my personal profile.  
> The old project has been **archived** to avoid confusion and duplication.  
>  
> 🔗 **Previous project:** [https://modrinth.com/mod/netherstuff-old](https://modrinth.com/mod/netherstuff-old)


###### _Developed using custom assets and tools, including MCreator._
